Changing value of SourceUri uses a little bit more memory each time

- Application type: WPF 4.0 
- Expected behaviour: Loading the gif should use the same amount of memory (roughly) each time when loading the same image.
- Actual behaviour: When reassigning the source URI it seems to claim slightly more memory each time.
- Steps to reproduce the problem:
  1. Set resource URI to null
  2. Navigate away
  3. Navigate to
  4. Set resource URI to GIF
